spotlight.mode.all: Spotlight and Siri: all notes, up to 5,000 (title and a short snippet; never locked or private notes).
spotlight.mode.off: Spotlight and Siri: no notes. Anything indexed before is removed.
spotlight.mode.recent: Spotlight and Siri: the 50 most recent notes (title and a short snippet; never locked or private notes).
spotlight.notSaved: This choice could not be saved on this device, so no notes are indexed.
